metadata.description: ALSETLab plugins for preparing research-paper companion repositories.

plugins.name: modelica-research-paper-companion-repo
plugins.description: Turn a research paper and its code repository into a polished, citable, archived open-source companion: README, CITATION.cff, Zenodo DOI, and a propose-first repo cleanup. Tuned for ALSETLab Modelica/Dymola/OpenIPSL/eFMI projects.
